en: One resin for priming, scratch coats, mortars (5–30 mm) and epoxy screeds (11–150 mm): fewer products on site, one mixing rule (1 : 1 with sand for the scratch coat, approx. 3 : 25 for the screed).
Published tensile adhesion ≥ 1.5 N/mm² on concrete that is dry to matt damp; the comparable primers state a dry substrate (≤ 4 % moisture, no rising damp) as the condition.
Flexural strength approx. 35 N/mm² (DIN EN 196-1) against approx. 15 N/mm² published for the Sikafloor-156 mortar — the figures are not from identical test bodies and are quoted as printed.
Pot life approx. 35 minutes at a simple 100 : 50 mixing ratio.
zh: 一支樹脂兼作底漆、刮塗層、砂漿（5–30 mm）與環氧整平層（11–150 mm）：現場產品更少，配比規則單純（刮塗層 1 : 1 加砂，整平層約 3 : 25）。
公告之拉拔黏結強度 ≥ 1.5 N/mm²，適用乾燥至微濕混凝土；同類底漆以乾燥基面（含水率 ≤ 4 %、無上升濕氣）為條件。
抗彎強度約 35 N/mm²（DIN EN 196-1），Sikafloor-156 砂漿公告值約 15 N/mm²——試體條件不同，依原文引用。
可使用時間約 35 分鐘，混合比 100 : 50 簡單易行。

en: A two-component resin primer — no cement component to batch (Sikafloor-81 EpoCem and Triblock P are three-component epoxy-cement systems), mixed in one step at 100 : 52.
Published as watertight against negative pressing water up to 3 bar; the comparable products are described for damp or green concrete without a stated pressure rating.
Overcoating window of 12 hours to 5 days gives the schedule room; the following resin layers bond to the sanded second coat.
The same resin serves as scratch coat and mortar binder (1 : 1 and approx. 3 : 25 with quartz sand).
zh: 雙組分樹脂底漆——無需配水泥粉料（Sikafloor-81 EpoCem 與 Triblock P 為三組分環氧水泥系統），100 : 52 一次混合。

同一樹脂可作刮塗層與砂漿膠結料（與石英砂 1 : 1 及約 3 : 25）。

可於拌合廠隨拌合水添加或於工地加入攪拌車，並載明每 m³ 拌合時間——程序符合台灣預拌混凝土實務（車上添加）。
依水泥種類（CEM I／II／III）公告最低膠結料用量，配比檢核即在資料表中。

en: Crystalline and hydrophobic in one powder: the pores are blocked by crystal growth and made water-repellent, two mechanisms against capillary water.
Dosage approx. 0.75–1.25 % of the cement — in water-soluble bags for the mixer truck, with the mixing time per m³ stated.
Minimum cement content from 270 kg/m³ (CEM I) is published; Sika WT-200 P and Idrocrete KR 1000 require 350 kg/m³.
The data sheet names the CEM types and blends for which the dosage applies; the comparable sheets give a general dosage per m³ or per 100 kg of cementitious material.
zh: 結晶與憎水合一之粉劑：孔隙既由晶體生長封閉，又具憎水性——對抗毛細水之雙重機制。
摻量約水泥重量 0.75–1.25 %——水溶性袋裝供攪拌車使用，並載明每 m³ 拌合時間。
公告最低水泥用量自 270 kg/m³（CEM I）起；Sika WT-200 P 與 Idrocrete KR 1000 要求 350 kg/m³。
資料表載明摻量適用之 CEM 種類與混合水泥；同類資料表僅給每 m³ 或每 100 kg 膠結料之通用摻量。
